name: PVTA ADA Paratransit
description: Shared-ride, door-to-door van transportation for individuals whose disabilities prevent them from riding the city bus. Available within 3/4 mile of a city bus route, on all days that city bus service operates. Requires a completed application mailed or dropped off at PVTA.
contact: 413-732-6248 ext. 2237 or toll-free 800-752-1638 ext. 2237; PVTA, 2808 Main Street, Springfield, MA 01107
documents_needed: Completed PVTA ADA paratransit application (must be completed in its entirety)

requirements.text: For individuals whose disabilities prevent them from riding the city bus service. Eligibility is determined through the PVTA ADA application.
Service is available within 3/4 mile of a city bus route.
PVTA is Fare-Free for FY27; no fares or passes needed for vans.

unknowns: Specific disability criteria and how long a decision takes
